title: ETF altseason? Solana, XRP funds buck crypto’s market sell-off
summary: SOL and XRP ETFs have attracted nearly $900 million in combined inflows, highlighting rare investor conviction amid an ongoing market rout.

title: Can Bitcoin really be a store of value? What pension funds are starting to discover
summary: As pension funds evaluate Bitcoin’s scarcity, resilience and inflation behavior, a core question emerges: Can BTC become a true institutional store of value?

title: Winklevoss twins bet on Zcash, privacy to combat AI threat
summary: Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss are betting on privacy protocols gaining major traction as AI continues to grow at an exponential rate.

title: aPriori denies insider role as mysterious entity claims most of APR airdrop
summary: While aPriori dismissed the claims related to insider activity, investors are still awaiting more details on the Sybil cluster that claimed 60% of the airdrop across 14,000 wallets.

title: Memecoin market sinks to 2025 low as $5B wiped out in a day
summary: Both memecoins and NFTs have plunged to their weakest levels since early 2025, with traders pulling back from speculative assets across the board.

title: Binance CEO says Bitcoin volatility matches broader markets amid 35% decline
summary: Binance CEO Richard Teng argued that Bitcoin’s current slide reflects broader risk-off deleveraging, and its volatility is in line with most major asset classes.

title: SoftBank’s PayPay changes the game for Binance Japan users
summary: Operated by SoftBank, the backer of one of the world’s top 10 public Bitcoin holders, PayPay is integrating with Binance Japan ahead of its expected US IPO in December.

title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF sheds $2.47B in November as outflows hit record $3.79B
summary: BlackRock’s IBIT drives November’s record ETF outflows, bleeding $2.47 billion and accounting for 63% of the $3.79 billion withdrawn from US spot Bitcoin ETFs.

title: Plume CEO tips RWA to grow 3-5x in 2026 as it grows past crypto natives
summary: Plume says that Securitize, a tokenization platform backed by BlackRock and Morgan Stanley, has inked a deal to deploy institutional-grade assets on Plume’s Nest staking protocol.

title: MSCI index likely to kick out crypto treasuries, exec warns
summary: If the MSCI decides to exclude digital asset treasuries, index-tracking funds would need to sell, and that alone “creates meaningful pressure on the affected names.”
